description: Figure 8 displays the distribution of answer refusal categories across several Large Language Models (LLMs) on the FACTBENCH dataset. The chart consists of eight slices, representing the categories “Safety Concerns/Misinformation,” “Sensitive/Private Information,” “Requests for Clarification/Requestioning,” “No Refusal,” “Other,” “Lack of Knowledge/Capabilities,” “Contradiction,” and “Undecidable.” The slices are colored green, purple, light blue, grey, yellow, dark green, orange, and red, respectively.  The proportions are approximately as follows: “No Refusal” constitutes the largest segment at around 60%, followed by “Lack of Knowledge/Capabilities” at roughly 15%. “Safety Concerns/Misinformation” and “Contradiction” each represent approximately 5% of the chart. “Sensitive/Private Information” and “Requests for Clarification/Requestioning” are each around 3-4%. “Other” and “Undecidable” each account for less than 3%. The chart includes a legend identifying each category with its corresponding color. The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest proportion, moving clockwise around the circle.
